name: storyeq-library-connector
description: The library connector bundled into StoryEQ plugins. Carries no library details; each machine keeps its own settings.

scripts.build: bun build src/server.js --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/library-arm64 && bun build src/server.js --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/library-x64 && gzip -9 -n -f -k dist/library-arm64 dist/library-x64
